description:
Add a visual progress bar to Slides 2 through 6 of the presentation 'onboarding_draft.odp'. 

Starting from Slide 2, draw a Blue rectangle at the bottom of the slide to represent progress:
- Slide 2: 20% of slide width
- Slide 3: 40% of slide width
- Slide 4: 60% of slide width
- Slide 5: 80% of slide width
- Slide 6: 100% of slide width

The bars should be consistent in height (approx 1cm) and color. Save the final presentation as '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/onboarding_final.odp'.
